prep.video1:
One useful idea is that mindset is a part of game development. My interpretation is that there are parts to game development. Mindset, structure, documentation, and the actual resources to develop your game.
Question: "How does separating the work into parts help with game development?"
prep.video2: Creativity and innovation is important for game developing. It helps you think outside the box for unique ideas. Its important to persevere and have the right mindset because its important to be able to adapt to change quickly. Keep in mind who are your fans and focus on the fans. Growth mindset: take on challenges, learn from failures, effort, accept feedback, surround yourself with the right people, and don't stop learning. To stay motivated: set clear goals, lists and deadlines. Stay organized.
prep.video3: Folder structure is important because it makes it easier to manage your project and share it with others.
prep.video4:
Folder structure is important for documentation for everything to be organized and for new members to see your project .
Question: How can we share our documents with others?
prep.video5: I observed how to start a project on Unity. Open a 3D project and title it the name of yor project. Its important to save this project in the folder with your project. On unity you can see all your assets and all sorts of information on the inspector. One question I have is how to actually make your game do stuff on Unity.
prep.video6: Observations: On Mixamo.com you can get 3d characters and then import them into Unity for your game. You can check your folders through Explorer ad this can also help with folder structure. You can rearrange or fix folders.  A folder with your project name should be created to organize everything.
prep.opinion: This can give us the right mindset to create any project The pipeline will help us turn a new story into something real by providng structure.
prep.questions: I observed the right mindset to bring to a team/project and know that its important to be motivated and have structure. Folder structure is important for game development.

nodes.text:
1. Breaking Work Into Parts
How does separating the work into parts help with game development?
Makes big projects easier to manage.
Keeps everyone organized.
Allows team members to focus on different tasks.
Helps identify and fix problems
Makes it easier to track progress and meet deadlines.
2. Creativity & Growth Mindset
Be creative and think outside the box.
Adapt quickly to changes.
Focus on your fans and what they enjoy.
Learn from mistakes and accept feedback.
Take on challenges and never stop learning.
Surround yourself with supportive people.
3. Staying Motivated & Organized
Set clear goals.
Make task lists and deadlines.
Stay organized and manage your time.
Persevere even when things get difficult.
4. Folder Structure & Sharing
Create a main folder with your project name.
Keep assets, documents, and files organized.
Use folders to make information easy to find.
Share organized folders and documents with teammates.
Good documentation helps new teammembers understand the project.
